# MUST Market

> Peer-to-peer marketplace where students at Mbeya University of Science and Technology (MUST) buy and sell used laptops, books, hostel gear, rooms and services, connecting directly via WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured shelves — hot deals, rooms & gheto, freshers starter pack and trending tech.
- [Browse](/browse): Every active and sold listing, searchable and filterable by category.
- [Sell an Item](/sell): Free listing form — title, price in TSh, photos, campus location, delivery time and WhatsApp number.
- [Feedback](/feedback): Send suggestions or issues to the MUST Market team.
- [Meet the Founder](/meet-the-founder): The story behind MUST Market.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How listing and contact data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Rules for buyers and sellers on the platform.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): All indexable URLs, including individual product pages.
